definitions.short: Jabets , the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H3258. Yabets יַעְבֵּץ proper name 1. masculine person Jabez, a man of the Calebites , 1Chr 4:9 (twice in verse); 4:10 (where interpreted as akin to עצב ; on position of this family compare Mey Judenthum 118 ); ᵐ5 Ιγαβης A Ιαγβης , Γαβης , GL Ιαβιης , Ιαβηλ , Ιαβεις . 2. location in Judah, apparently near Bethlehem 1Chr 2:55 (compare 2:54 ); ᵐ5 Γαμες A Γαβης ᵐ5 L Ιαβις .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to grieve ; sorrowful ;
